verdict.rationale: DOR's open guidance pages say up front that you need a My DOR online account, that the same account is used to file taxes, that B&O returns must be filed through MyDOR, and that a UBI number is required whenever you file. They also note an express-file path that needs no login. However, the pack never sets out any identity-proofing steps such as ID verification, MFA or security codes, and the authenticated portal could not be inspected to confirm nothing further appears mid-flow. Missing for 10: documented identity-proofing or verification steps, a complete pre-start checklist of account-creation requirements, and hands-on confirmation that no undisclosed steps surface during sign-up or filing.

support.subject: As a founder, the service publishes exactly which account, credential, and identity-proofing steps stand between me and filing — stated before I start, not discovered mid-flow

citations.quote: Create an online account in our secure My DOR system. This account will also be used to file your taxes and make changes to your business.
You must report and pay B&O tax on the Excise Tax Return using MyDOR, the department's online filing tool.
you'll need it whenever you file your taxes or make changes to your business.
Express file online. No login required.
